mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite (user_id, course_id, created_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.title, c.cover_image AS coverImage, c.teacher_name AS teacherName, c.price, t.name AS typeName, f.created_time AS favoriteTime FROM favorite f JOIN course c ON f.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN course_type t ON c.type_id = t.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
